title: Graduate Engineer
content_text: Full time fixed term until 9 April 2027 with potential to extend. BAND 5 $87,007-$100,156 inclusive of superannuation, plus monthly RDO. Join Infrastructure Delivery and Major Projects team. Contribute to planning, design and delivery of infrastructure projects including roads, drainage, buildings and open spaces. Full project lifecycle: investigations, prioritisation, procurement, contract supervision and delivery. Requirements: Degree in Civil Engineering eligible for membership with Engineers Australia; understanding of civil design, construction and project management principles; Victorian Driver's Licence; sound computer skills Microsoft Office, exposure to project management and drafting software desirable. Applications close 5pm on 3 May 2026 via application form. careers@bawbawshire.vic.gov.au for assistance. Proof of eligibility to work in Australia if selected for interview.
apply_instructions: Apply online at applynow.net.au/jobs/BAW594-graduate-engineer with resume and covering letter before 5pm 3 May 2026. Assistance: careers@bawbawshire.vic.gov.au or (03) 5624 2411.
